q: 这段请求合并代码里，inflight 字典的作用是？

why: inflight 是 key → Future 的映射：第一个请求负责真正取数，后续同 key 请求共享那个 Future 的结果，取完即删。
why_en: The inflight map tracks keys already being fetched so concurrent requests await the same future instead of issuing duplicate backend calls.
codeSample:
class CoalescingCache:
    def __init__(self):
        self.inflight = {}  # key -> Future

    async def get(self, key):
        if key in self.inflight:          # 已有请求在取
            return await self.inflight[key]
        future = asyncio.Future()
        self.inflight[key] = future
        try:
            value = await fetch_from_backend(key)
            future.set_result(value)
            return value
        finally:
            del self.inflight[key]
